title: CellChatESS: Efficient Signal Streaming for CellChat inference
description: CellChatESS 0.2.2 release candidate for triMean-based non-spatial CellChat inference. The revised core study uses pinned CellChat 2.2.0.9001 and direct AutoZyme comparison. Includes the direct single-effective-gene expression path, finite non-negative input validation, and optional OpenMP. Historical 1.6.1/0.1.1 evidence is tracked separately. Deposition is pending author review.
